SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_GR_NO, COUNT(LEGACY_GR_SEQ) LEGACY_COUNT FROM V_KEP_GR WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY LEGACY_GR_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HUNG' AS BUYER, 'KM' AS SITE, PLANT , STATUS , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , GR_DATE , LEGACY_PR_NO , LEGACY_PR_SEQ , LEGACY_GR_NO , LEGACY_GR_SEQ , DELY_TO_LOCATION , RO_QTY , RO_AMT , REMARK , '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM V_KEP_GR WHERE LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE V_KEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
